display_long_description:
**Evil Inside VR** is a first-person psychological horror game. After the death of his mother and the arrest of his father, Mark tries to contact her using a spiritual board, but it explodes mysteriously, unleashing terrifying paranormal events.
[media]
Playing as Mark, a teenager now responsible for his little brother, you must collect the scattered fragments of the board to reconnect with his mother and uncover the truth behind what happened.

Explore a constantly shifting house where reality distorts and fear grows with every step. Strange noises, flickering lights, and haunting visions blur the line between imagination and reality. Mark thought he was alone… but something else is there.

Face your fears, uncover dark secrets, and survive the chilling mystery that surrounds Evil Inside. Only by confronting the unknown can you discover what really happened—and why nothing adds up.
